issues.description: The simulate(...) method in the template for Exercise 2 is annotated to return list[complex] (statevector) but the problem statement and the solution expect/supply simulation counts (a histogram/dictionary). This return-type mismatch between the template signature and the intended behavior (and reference implementation) will confuse students about what to return and may lead to incorrect type expectations in tests and example usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template signature and docstring for simulate(...) in ex2_grover_multi_qubit_with_auxiliary_qubit.py to indicate it should return simulation counts (e.g. dict[str, int]) to match the problem statement and the solution. Ensure the example and instructions consistently mention returning counts and, if needed, adjust the template type hint to `-> dict[str, int]`.
